trace.purpose: Find the model year and powertrain combination with the highest total warranty cost divided by the number of vehicles delivered in that combination.

SELECT
  v.model_year,
  v.powertrain,
  COALESCE(SUM(w.cost_eur), 0) AS total_warranty_cost,

  COALESCE(SUM(w.cost_eur), 0) / COUNT(v.vin) AS cost_per_vehicle
FROM gishub.fleet.vehicles v
LEFT JOIN gishub.fleet.warranty_claims w ON v.vin = w.vin
